description: Digitize an archaeological section drawing of 'Test Pit 4' in LibreCAD. Set units to Meters. Draw a trench outline (4m wide x 2m deep). Create three soil layers using polylines/splines for the interfaces: Topsoil (top), Clay (middle), and Gravel (bottom). Apply specific hatch patterns: 'ANSI31' (diagonal) for Topsoil, 'ANSI37' (cross) for Clay, and 'AR-SAND' (or 'ANSI33') for Gravel. Organize these on named layers: 'BOUNDARIES', 'HATCH-TOPSOIL', 'HATCH-CLAY', 'HATCH-GRAVEL', and 'TEXT'. Add text labels for each context. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/section_drawing.dxf'.
